description: Bulk-update option labels of an organization enum/set field. Atomic: the whole request fails if any option ID does not exist.

field_code.description: The field_code (40-char hash for custom fields) from the field create/list response. NOT the human field name.

options.description: Options to update (at least one). Atomic: the whole request fails if any option ID does not exist.

name: pipedrive_update_organization_field_options
